responsibility: Resolves HIR lifetime and other binder references into the compiler's bound-variable model by classifying parameters as early, late, or free, assigning Debruijn indices across nested binders and trait-object elision scopes, recording late-bound variable lists and opaque captured lifetimes, and diagnosing invalid late-bound non-region parameters. It is also responsible for rejecting illegal captures of late-bound type or const parameters by nested opaque types and related binder constructs, including cases involving the `non_lifetime_binders` feature where an opaque or associated type constraint could otherwise carry escaping bound variables into later well-formedness predicates.
